_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Condiments, Sauces and Dressings Program Manual for Category 32. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.condiments-sauces-and-dressings is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 32 Program Manual. Five live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on every lot. Metal safety only.
